Palabra por palabra

Paste any Spanish text: an article, song lyrics, a script. You’ll translate it one word at a time, then the whole sentence. Everything runs in your browser, with no accounts and no usage costs.

Word meanings come from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0), compiled by the spanish_data project, and cover about 11,000 common words. Sentences are checked with the Helsinki-NLP Opus-MT Spanish-English model (CC BY 4.0), run through Transformers.js. The model (about 75 MB) downloads once on your first practice session, then your browser keeps it. Nothing you type leaves your device.
